name: @pipeworx/mcp-who-iris

tools.name: who_iris_search
tools.description: Search WHO publications and official documents — guidelines, technical reports, World Health Reports, weekly epidemiological records and governing-body papers — by topic, disease, author or title. Returns each publication with its title, authors, publication date, document type, MeSH subjects, abstract and a permanent link. Use to find what the World Health Organization has actually published on a health topic.

query.description: Topic, disease, title words or author, e.g. "tuberculosis treatment guidelines".

page.description: Zero-based page number for paging through results.

tools.name: who_iris_item
tools.description: Get the full record for one WHO publication including its downloadable files — direct PDF links with filename, size and format. Use after who_iris_search to obtain the actual document, or to check what file formats and translations a WHO publication is available in.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-who-iris forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the who-iris pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
